baseVersion.description:
Version the edits were computed against. Older versions are rebased; a conflict fails
with `ContentModified`.

id.description: Id of the request to cancel; it completes with `RequestCancelled`.

CommandCall.description: A command with arguments, e.g. the action of a status item or a tree node.

key.description: A key (`editor.fontSize`) or a section prefix (`java`) returning an object.

uri.description: Resource whose workspace folder settings apply.

key.description: Key in the plugin's own namespace.

value.description: `null` removes the value from the target layer.

Content.description: Bytes in JSON: UTF-8 text as is, anything else base64-encoded (RFC 4648, with padding).

uris.description: Files whose merged diagnostics changed; read them from the Language service.

changes.description: Edits in application order, positions relative to the previous version.

version.description: Version after the change; exactly one more than the previous event for this document.
Version of the open document; `null` when the text was read from storage.

DocumentVersion.description: Monotonic document version; every transaction increments it by one.

clear.description: URIs whose decorations from this plugin are removed.

mtimeMs.description: Modification time, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

base.description: Directory the glob is relative to; all workspace folders when omitted.

create.description: Create the file if it does not exist.

methods.description:
Plugin-to-host methods the host implements. Minor versions add methods; plugins check
this list instead of comparing versions.

apiVersion.description: Protocol version of the host, e.g. `0.1.0`.

config.description: Current values of the plugin's own settings namespace.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin being initialized, as in its manifest.

storage.description: Directories of the plugin's own, created by the host.

apiVersion.description: Protocol version of the plugin; a different major version fails the handshake.

target.description: Module or component inside the plugin.

edit.description: An LSP `WorkspaceEdit`, positions in the server's encoding.

params.description: LSP params, positions in the server's encoding.

MiddlewareResult.description: What the core does with an intercepted message.

oneOf.description: Answer with this result instead of the default handling.
Continue with the default handling, with possibly modified params.

preview.description: Open in a preview tab that the next preview replaces.

lspMiddleware.description: LSP methods the plugin intercepts through `lsp/middleware/request`.

methods.description:
Optional host-to-plugin methods the plugin handles, e.g. `state/save`,
`document/resolveContent`, `task/provide`, `ui/tree/getChildren`.

reason.description: Why the plugin is in this state, e.g. a missing required interface.

PluginStorage.description: Where a plugin keeps files: `data` survives updates of the plugin, `cache` may be deleted.

Position.description: Position in a document: zero-based line and UTF-8 byte offset inside that line.

character.description: UTF-8 byte offset inside the line.

signal.description: Number of the signal that terminated the process.
Sent to the whole process group.

ProcessSpec.description: What to run. The owner is the calling plugin; the host records it.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory; the first workspace folder when omitted.

killOnOwnerExit.description: Kill the process tree when the owning plugin stops.

pty.description: Run in a pseudo-terminal of this size.

data.description: Bytes for stdin (or the terminal input).

cancellable.description: Show a cancel button; cancellation arrives as `ui/progress/cancel`.

ProgressToken.description: Token that ties progress reports to an operation, chosen by the side that starts it.

topic.description: Topic in the plugin's own namespace.

command.description: A command created at runtime; commands from the manifest need no registration.

RequestId.description: Request id: a number or a string, as in JSON-RPC 2.0.

ResponseError.description: Error object of a failed response.

topics.description: Topics whose subscriptions were dropped after a queue overflow.

state.description: Opaque state the plugin wants back after a reload.

caller.description: The consumer that made the call.

key.description: Context key in the plugin's own namespace, e.g. `java.serverReady`.

id.description: Item id, unique within the plugin.

actions.description: Button labels; the chosen one is returned.

priority.description: Higher values are placed closer to the edge.

StreamId.description: Binary stream carried by frames of kind 1 (data) and 2 (close).

glob.description: Glob over URIs for URI-carrying topics such as `fs.changed`.

topics.description: Topics such as `document.changed`, or a namespace prefix such as `document.*`.

spec.description: What to run; may be left empty by `task/provide` and filled by `task/resolve`.

type.description: Task provider type declared in the manifest.

exitCode.description: `null` when the process was killed by a signal.

TextEdit.description: Replacement of `range` with `new_text`; an empty range inserts, empty text deletes.

children.description:
Children known up front; `null` for a collapsible node means the host asks
`ui/tree/getChildren` when the node is expanded.

command.description: Run when the node is activated.

contextValue.description: Matched by `viewItem == ...` in when-expressions of context menus.

viewId.description: View declared in the plugin manifest.

children.description: New children; `null` makes the host ask `ui/tree/getChildren` again.

nodeId.description: Node whose children changed; `null` for the roots.

WorkspaceFolder.description: A workspace folder the IDE has open.

config.changed.description: Effective values of these settings changed.

document.changed.description: A transaction was applied to a document.

document.closed.description: A document was closed in the core.

document.opened.description: A document was opened in the core.

document.saved.description: A document was written to storage.

fs.changed.description: Batch of file system changes, coalesced over 50-100 ms.

interface.availabilityChanged.description: A provider of an inter-plugin interface appeared or disappeared.

language.statusChanged.description: Language servers started, stopped or reported progress; read the status again.

plugin.stateChanged.description: A plugin moved to another lifecycle state.

terminal.opened.description: A terminal started; the UI shows it.

$/log.description: A log record for the IDE log.

$/progress.description: Progress or partial results of a request that carried a progress token.

$/resync.description: Subscriptions were dropped: re-read state (`document/snapshot`) and subscribe again.

command/execute.description: Execute any command (core or another plugin) and return its result.

command/invoke.description: Run a command contributed or registered by this plugin.

command/register.description: Register a runtime command handled by this plugin; released when the plugin stops.

command/setContext.description: Set a context key used by when-expressions.

config/changed.description: Settings of the plugin's namespace changed.

config/get.description: Effective value of a setting or section.

config/update.description: Change a setting in the plugin's namespace.

document/open.description: Open a document in the core without showing it.

document/read.description: Current text: the open buffer if any, otherwise the stored file.

document/resolveContent.description: Content of a read-only document in a URI scheme the plugin owns.

document/snapshot.description: Full state of an open document; used to resynchronize.

event/notify.description: Deliver an event to a subscriber.

event/publish.description: Publish an event in the plugin's own namespace.

fs/rename.description: Rename or move a file or directory.

fs/watch.description: Watch files; changes arrive as `fs.changed` events of the returned subscription.

initialize.description: Handshake: versions, capabilities, workspace, settings and locale.

initialized.description: Handshake finished; the plugin may start sending requests.

lsp/applyEdit.description: Apply a workspace edit of a language server, e.g. for a client-side command.

lsp/middleware/request.description: Intercept a message the plugin declared in `lspMiddleware`.

lsp/resolveLaunch.description: Command line and initialization options for a language server.

lsp/sendRequest.description: Send a request to a running language server.

process/exited.description: A process started by the plugin exited; its output streams are closed before this.

process/spawn.description: Start a process with piped output.

process/spawnPty.description: Start a process in a pseudo-terminal (`spec.pty` is required).

service/call.description: Call a method of an interface declared in `[[consumes]]`.

service/invoke.description: Handle a call to an interface declared in `[[provides]]`.

shutdown.description: Stop work and release resources; the host sends `exit` afterwards.

state/restore.description: Optional: restore state saved by a previous instance.

state/save.description: Optional: return state to hand over to the next instance.

task/provide.description: List the tasks of a provider type.

task/resolve.description: Fill in the process spec of a task before it runs.

task/run.description: Run a task; `task.started` and `task.finished` report its execution.

ui/fileDecorations.description: Set or clear badges and colors of files in trees and tabs.

ui/openDocument.description: Show a document in the editor.

ui/progress/begin.description: Start showing progress of a long operation.

ui/progress/cancel.description: The user cancelled a cancellable progress.

ui/setStatusItem.description: Create, update or remove a status bar item.

ui/showInput.description: Ask the user for a line of text; `null` when dismissed.

ui/showMessage.description: Show a notification, optionally with action buttons.

ui/showQuickPick.description: Let the user pick from a list; `null` when dismissed.

ui/tree/getChildren.description: Lazily load the children of an expanded node.

ui/tree/setModel.description: Replace the whole model of a tree view.

ui/tree/update.description: Replace or invalidate the children of one node.
